bagPolicy.summary: Permitted bags are clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, and clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches. Medical items and diaper bags are allowed after inspection.
